_comment: Small hand-built offline lookup that flags service versions known to be outdated or vulnerable. This is NOT a live CVE feed; it's a curated teaching table tuned to the Metasploitable/Win7 lab. 'match' is checked against the '<product> <version>' string (case-insensitive substring). Severity: info < low < medium < high < critical.

entries.title: vsftpd 2.3.4 backdoor command execution
entries.note: This exact build shipped with a backdoor that opens a root shell on port 6200 when a username ending in ':)' is sent.

entries.title: UnrealIRCd 3.2.8.1 backdoor
entries.note: The distributed tarball was trojaned; a crafted message runs arbitrary commands as the IRC user.

entries.title: distccd remote code execution
entries.note: distcc's daemon allows remote attackers to run arbitrary commands via compilation jobs when not restricted.

entries.title: Samba 3.0.x 'username map script' command injection
entries.note: Shell metacharacters in the username field are passed to /bin/sh when the username map script option is set.

entries.title: Debian OpenSSL predictable PRNG (affects OpenSSH keys)
entries.note: Keys generated on affected Debian/Ubuntu systems in this era come from a tiny keyspace and are brute-forceable.

entries.title: ProFTPD 1.3.x pre-auth stack overflow
entries.note: A stack overflow in the Telnet IAC handling can lead to remote code execution before authentication.

entries.title: Apache 2.2.8 outdated — multiple known issues
entries.note: This branch is long past end-of-life and carries several disclosed vulnerabilities; upgrade strongly advised.

entries.title: MySQL 5.0.x end-of-life
entries.note: MySQL 5.0 reached end-of-life in 2012 and no longer receives security fixes.

entries.title: IIS 7.5 (Windows 7 / Server 2008 R2 era) outdated
entries.note: Underlying OS is out of mainstream support; patch level should be verified against current advisories.

entries.title: Telnet service exposed
entries.note: Telnet transmits credentials in cleartext. Its mere presence is a finding; replace with SSH.
